Backups include transactions, drafts and attachments, and are not encrypted. Store them securely and check the sync settings of your chosen file service.

Existing books, accounts, transactions, drafts and settings will be replaced. A local snapshot is kept before restoring and can be exported here. It is replaced the next time you replace data and deleted if you uninstall the app.
